description: Nextgen STP GTT fixtures (DESIGN §3 numbering plan template, §9.4.2, §10.2 P5+P7). Internal service PCs 200-299 are hidden from peers; GTT rewrites the CdPA to hidden DPC+SSN and never touches the CgPA. GT patterns use jSS7-native grammar ('/' mask sections, '*' = rest of digits).

rules.description: USSD exact-match shortcode inside the USSD range — specificity must beat the wildcard range.
USSD GT range 2519* -> hidden USSDGW cluster PC 201, USSD service SSN 251 (appears after GTT only).
SMSC GT range 2511* -> hidden SMSC cluster PC 202, SMSC SSN 8.
GMLC GT range 2512* -> hidden GMLC cluster PC 203, GMLC/LCS SSN 145.
